
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19854860" title="发布于 2026-04-12 11:56">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript扩展多种脚本语言</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行库，支持扩展多种脚本语言。前一篇文章<a title="AScript如何实现中文脚本引擎" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19849198" target="_blank">《AScript如何实现中文脚本引擎》</a>中演示了扩展中文语言示例，本篇将更深入的理解AScript的多语言机制，以及如何在脚本中嵌入多种脚本语言。</p>
<h3>一、自定义语法</h3>
<p>AScript底层解析脚本生成token流，语法解析器对token流进行处理，就会调用<strong><em>ITokenHandler</em></strong>处理器，该接口定义如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ITokenHandler
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> token处理
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="analyzer"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">语法分析器</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="e"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">当前token、语法树及上下文信息</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Build(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><strong><em>DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer</em></strong>参数为语法分析器，可以调用其中的BuildOneStatement或者BuildMultiStatement方法来读取一条或多条语句。</p>
<p>自定义语法就是对当前token以及前后语句进行处理，将结果添加到语法树，来实现期望的逻辑功能。</p>
<p>示例：定义sql条件语句的and语法</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;![CDATA[age&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">20 and age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;50]]&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AndTokenHandler : ITokenHandler
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> AndTokenHandler Instance = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AndTokenHandler();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Build(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         e.IsHandled = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e.Ignore)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> op = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OperatorNode(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer.OperatorPriorities[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&amp;&amp;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>], <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.TreeBuilder.AddOperator(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.Control, op);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>sql中的and语法等效于C#中的&amp;&amp;操作符，所以优先级取&amp;&amp;操作符的优先级，同时sql语言环境中需要注册and函数：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, AndAlsoOperator.Instance);</span>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>二、定义语言</h3>
<p>AScript中提供了ScriptLang类来扩展语言，该类包含类型、变量、函数、语法解析（ITokenHandler）管理。</p>
<p>多语言势必会带来语法兼容问题，比如sql条件中的"="号是相等的意思，等效于C#中的"=="，跟C#中的赋值符号"="有冲突，可设置属性Compatible=false表示不兼容默认语言，在脚本或ScriptContext上下文中需要指定语言才能执行。</p>
<p>示例：定义Sql语言（这里只实现一个简单的条件判断功能）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SqlLang : ScriptLang
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> SqlLang Instance = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SqlLang();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SqlLang()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Compatible = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, DotOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, BoolNotOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, LessThanOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, GreaterThanOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, EqualOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, GreaterThanOrEqualOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, LessThanOrEqualOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, NotEqualOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, AndAlsoOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>         AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">or</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, OrElseOperator.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, AndTokenHandler.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AND</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, AndTokenHandler.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">or</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, OrTokenHandler.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OR</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, OrTokenHandler.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, EqualTokenHandler.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">like</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, LikeTokenHandler.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>         AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LIKE</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, LikeTokenHandler.Instance);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>由于AScript是区分大小写的，注册token时大小写都注册一下，便于sql语句中支持大小写语法，示例中的"or"、"like"等语法代码不一一列出了，感兴趣的同学可以到开源项目的单元测试中查看，后续可能会开发一个比较完备的sql语言脚本。</p>
<p>注册SqlLang：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">Script.Langs[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = SqlLang.Instance;</span>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>三、执行指定语言脚本</h3>
<p>如果不指定语言，则使用默认且兼容的语言来执行脚本。</p>
<p>1、ScriptContext中设置Langs属性来指定脚本语言</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p.Name like 'to%' or p.Age&gt;20 and p.Age&lt;50</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> script.Context.Langs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> matchFunc = script.Compile&lt;Person, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;(s, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;Person&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tony</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">19</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">san</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">70</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> matchedList =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list.Where(matchFunc).ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, matchedList.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tony</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, matchedList[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, matchedList[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">san</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, matchedList[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>].Name);</pre>
</div>
<p>2、脚本中通过#lang语法嵌入其他语言</p>
<p>指定多个语言使用逗号","分隔，如：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">#lang 中文,CSharp</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bool isMatch(Person p) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #lang sql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    p.Age&gt;20 and p.Age&lt;50 or p.Name like 'to%' or p.Name='pen';
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    #end
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var matchedList = new List&lt;Person&gt;();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">foreach(var item in list) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">if (isMatch(item)) matchedList.Add(item);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">matchedList;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;Person&gt;
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tony</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">19</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Person(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">san</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> script.Context.AddType&lt;Person&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, list);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> matchedList = script.Eval&lt;List&lt;Person&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, matchedList.Count);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tony</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, matchedList[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tom</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, matchedList[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Name);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">san</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, matchedList[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>].Name);</pre>
</div>
<h3>四、结语</h3>
<p>AScript 的多语言扩展能力，在同一脚本中嵌入不同脚本语言，让开发者和用户可以使用最合适的语言进行脚本配置，提高配置灵活性和产品体验。</p>
<p>AScript开源地址：<a class="ne-link" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript"><span class="ne-text">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</span></a></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
